title: Apollo 3: The Rover That Chases Ice
tagline: Carry a one-meter drill to the Moon's coldest places.

goal.text: Drive near a permanently shadowed crater and drill for ice
goal.why: Knowing where the ice is tells us where future crews can get water

facts.text: NASA's VIPER rover was designed to explore the Moon in search of ice and other resources, on a planned 100-day mission at the South Pole.
VIPER is designed to use three instruments and a 3.28-foot (1-meter) drill to analyze lunar soil at a range of depths and temperatures.
Permanently shadowed craters are some of the coldest spots in the solar system, where ice reserves have endured for billions of years.
On September 19, 2025, NASA announced that VIPER will be delivered to Mons Mouton by a Blue Origin Blue Moon MK-1 lander.

ship.rationale: The rover must survive long dark stretches and carry a drill, so batteries and payload mass matter most.

items.prompt: Switch the drill motor OFF until landing

cruise.story: Pressure is dropping in a fuel line. Reconnect the pipes.
Charged particles are on the way. Move the crew behind the shield.
A small course nudge is needed. Align the rings.

tasks.title: Drill and collect a sample
tasks.hint: Follow the beeps: they speed up near the cold spot

voice_lines.text: Apollo 3, Houston. Your rover carries a one-meter drill. We want to know what is hiding in the cold dark.
Apollo 3, go for launch. Good luck out there.
Apollo 3, drive-ready ground is flat ground. Choose with care.
Apollo 3, sample secured. The ice will tell us a lot. Good work.
